item.title: Ethiopian Airlines Crowned Africa's Best in 2026 APEX Awards, Backed by Over a Million Passenger Votes
item.description: Ethiopian Airlines won the 2026 APEX Passenger Choice Award for Best Airline in Africa on May 4, drawn from more than one million verified ratings across 600+ global carriers. The recognition highlights the airline's service strength across its network of 160+ destinations.

item.title: Ethiopia More Than Doubles Power Capacity in Seven Years, Cementing Its Lead as Africa's Renewable Energy Hub
item.description: Ethiopia has expanded power generation from 4,462 to 9,752 megawatts over seven years, with nearly 100% sourced from renewables — chiefly hydropower anchored by the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam. National electricity access has climbed from 44% to 54% over the same period.

item.title: Lalibela's Ethiopian Feasts Turn Watertown Square Into a Comfort-Food Destination
item.description: Restaurant Lalibela is drawing diners to Watertown Square with traditional Ethiopian feasts, emerging as a standout comfort-food spot in the area. The eatery joins a growing wave of Ethiopian cuisine gaining mainstream recognition abroad.
